1: #!/usr/bin/env python3

3: 
4: Usage: python ultra-log-report.py <log> [<log> ...]
5: 
6: Accepts either the Go runtime log (raw "tcp stream ended ..." lines) or the
7: client app log that embeds it. Reports, per forward:
8: 
9:   * paired stream outcomes: OK (downstream bytes > 0), SILENT (upstream bytes > 0
10:     and downstream bytes == 0), idle (nothing moved in either direction)
11:   * the quarantine lifetime distribution, split into the two failure modes seen
12:     on 2026-09-14: INSTANT (<= 250 ms, the relay closed right after its ACK) and
13:     SILENT-HANG (~1000 ms, the relay accepted and then answered nothing)
14:   * setup failures ("no healthy authorized candidate") and the longest window in
15:     which the forward could not serve a single stream
16:   * the longest run of minutes with no successful stream at all
17: 
18: Nothing here is specific to one incident; it is the reusable read-out for any
19: future silent-relay report.
20: """
21: import datetime
22: import re
23: import sys
24: from collections import Counter, defaultdict
25: 
26: END = re.compile(
27:     r"(\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d \d\d:\d\d:\d\d).*tcp stream ended forward_id=(\d+) "
28:     r"direction=(\w+) reason=(\w+) generation=(\w+) selection_ref=(\S+) "
29:     r"duration_ms=(\d+) bytes=(\d+)"
30: )
31: QUAR = re.compile(
32:     r"(\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d \d\d:\d\d:\d\d).*tcp candidate quarantined forward_id=(\d+) "
33:     r"selection_ref=(\S+) reason=(\w+) lifetime_ms=(\d+) upstream_bytes=(\d+)"
34: )
35: FAIL = re.compile(r"(\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d \d\d:\d\d:\d\d).*tcp stream setup failed forward_id=(\d+)")
36: GEN = re.compile(r"tcp stream ended forward_id=(\d+) direction=\w+ reason=\w+ generation=(\w+)")
37: LEASE = re.compile(r"(\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d \d\d:\d\d:\d\d).*ultra lease selection started forward_id=(\d+) candidates=(\d+)")
38: NOTLISTEN = re.compile(r"(\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d \d\d:\d\d:\d\d).*forward (\d+): local port (\d+) not listening")
39: 
40: 
41: def parse(path):
42:     out = dict(ends=[], quars=[], fails=[], gens=defaultdict(set), leases=[], notlisten=[])
43:     for line in open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
44:         m = END.search(line)
45:         if m:
46:             t = datetime.datetime.strptime(m.group(1), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
47:             dur = int(m.group(7))
48:             out["ends"].append(dict(
49:                 t=t, start=t - datetime.timedelta(milliseconds=dur), fwd=int(m.group(2)),
50:                 dir=m.group(3), gen=m.group(5)[:8], sel=m.group(6), dur=dur, by=int(m.group(8))))
51:             out["gens"][int(m.group(2))].add(m.group(5)[:8])
52:             continue
53:         m = QUAR.search(line)
54:         if m:
55:             out["quars"].append((m.group(1), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(5)), int(m.group(6))))

62:         if m:

64:             continue

66:         if m:
67:             out["notlisten"].append((m.group(1), int(m.group(2)), m.group(3)))
